method: Two real paint writes per native pixel, Auto targets, all source variants, four active/pressed views, on a disposable document. W = writable source; - = no source. Coverage rows distinguish runtime overlays, opaque spectrum and palette-only fill.
note: Intrinsic bitmap capability, not permission under the current clip, color mask, alpha lock or locked paint layer. No artwork, view, clipboard, history or dirty state is changed. Writable does not mean visible through opaque runtime content.

legend.D: Paintable bitmap; no runtime footprint at this pixel.
legend.O: Paintable bitmap, but the GPU player covers it with the solid VISCOLOR spectrum background even while stopped. The editor can show paint the player hides.
legend.P: No bitmap source: playlist color fill. Use PLEDIT.TXT colors.
legend.R: Paintable bitmap beneath a runtime footprint. Only live content may cover the artwork; this is NOT an inaccessible region.
legend.S: Paintable sprite with states or repeated cells. Inspect variants and shared destinations.
legend.X: No mapped bitmap source on this surface.

coverage.note: Coverage describes source ownership, independent of selection, clip, masks and locked paint planes. Runtime footprints are not exclusion masks: inspect the exact pixels, keep live content legible, and verify the actual GPU player. Bitmap fonts and shared cells may affect other states or locations.
